_comment: Phase 25 COMPLIANCE-01 (D-03 / OQ#4) coverage ratchet baseline. Counts = number of shipped rules carrying a non-empty mapping per framework; total_rules = full denominator (ALL shipped rules, mapped or not). The release.yml coverage-regression gate FAILS if any framework count drops below these numbers. Bump these counts (commit) in the same PR that adds mappings so the ratchet only ever rises.
